Name: Mechanical Water Pump
Description: Four tiers of worker-free mechanical drinking-water pumps for Timberborn 1.1. Pay research, materials and mechanical power instead of beaver labour. Animated flywheels, gears and pistons driven by the mechanical network (speed follows power), a maintenance system (condition, upkeep materials, 2-hour downtime), four-tier balance at 3/6/15/20 Water per hour, internal water storage with vanilla hauling to tanks, a JSON config file, English / Simplified Chinese / Traditional Chinese localization, and optional Timber Pipes valve extraction detected at runtime and never required. Made in collaboration with DeepSeek V4.1 Flash.
